name: The Wolf and the Holy Man
source:
A town is terrorised by the threat of a wolf that devours both lifestock and man. When a wandering priest—widely known as a Holy Man—arrives there, he vows to solve the situation without any bloodshed. But this beast might be a little different than what this pilgrim expects.

[From [url=https://cardigan-cardigan.itch.io/wolf-and-holy-man]Itch.io[/url]]
